description: AI Proposal Maker turns what you draft in chat into a branded, sendable client proposal. Describe the project and your price, and it lays out a professional document with a cover, scope, and pricing. Get a shareable hosted link the moment it's ready, download a polished PDF, or publish a branded link you can track when the client opens it. Works for quotes and statements of work too. No account needed to start.

defaultPrompt: Make a proposal I can send for Northwind Skincare's Webflow redesign, ~$7k.
Draft a Webflow proposal for Northwind Skincare with itemized pricing.
